The '''Shvash Gas Cooperative''' was a company owned and ran by [[Vleen Argoe]], located at [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. The company sold [[shvash gas]] which was mined directly from the surface of Gelgelar, in large tanks to freighter captains.

The company was loosely affiliated with [[Blycks]], another gas company, which they sold their gas to.
